observations: The page number «( 3 )» stands at the head of the page, centred. The page has no footnotes and no signature.

Numerals are printed in small capitals between points: «.cc.», «.ccc.», «.dcccc.» (L02-L03, L11), «.ii.» and «.iii.» milia (L04-L05); L13: «.ix. m.», nine thousand, with «m.» in small capitals after the point of «.ix.», and «.x̄.», ten thousand, an x in small capitals with a bar over it.
L16: «superiora (sic)»: the edition marks the form of the manuscript with «(sic)» in italics.
L17: the t of the first word, «et», shows its stem and foot but not its cross stroke and its pointed top, so that it looks like an l; transcribed «et».
L25: «.o. litere», the letter o between points, in roman type.

Spaces at punctuation: L28, «differentia,esset»: the gap after the comma is 7 px, where the word spaces of the line are 15 to 21 px, and no space is transcribed. Before the colons of L27 («eam :») and L32 («decenorum :») the gap is 10 px, a thin space, and before the semicolons of L02 and L03 and the comma of L20 a full space; transcribed with a space.
copy_matter: A reader's marks in pencil: L07, a vertical stroke through the «ff» of «differentia»; L28, a curve under «ni» of «decenis», and «decenus» written in the right margin beside the line. Not part of the edition.
